Withering leaf moisture/pliabilityను మార్చుతుంది; rolling/crushing tissuesను disrupt చేస్తుంది; black-tea oxidation enzymatic reactionsను అనుమతిస్తుంది; green-tea heat treatment early oxidationను తగ్గిస్తుంది. Ordinary black-tea oxidationను microbial alcohol fermentationతో కలపకండి.

questions.question_en: Which AP crop-location confusion should be avoided?
questions.question_te: ఏ AP crop-location confusion నివారించాలి?
options: Treating Araku coffee geography as proof of a major tea belt
Recognising Nilgiris as a tea region
Distinguishing Assam valley and Darjeeling hills
Checking production years
option_explanations: Coffee identity does not establish tea production.
That is a valid tea association.
The terrain distinction is useful.
Dated statistics are required.

questions.question_en: Which tea operation is distinct from harvesting young shoots?
questions.question_te: Young shoots harvest నుంచి వేరే operation ఏది?
options: Pruning to manage bush framework
Shoot harvesting by another name
Plucking by definition
Picking the designated flush
option_explanations: Pruning manages structure/regrowth rather than collecting the usual plucked crop.
That repeats the harvest meaning.
Plucking is the harvesting process.
That is a form of plucking.
